reading.body:
Brightwheel is catalogued as an education AI product, but no AI feature in it has been verified.

The only AI named anywhere in the record is on the company's own contact form, where submitting details means agreeing to be reached by automated technology, prerecorded messages, or AI-assisted systems for marketing. That is AI pointed at sales outreach, not at the childcare work of billing, attendance, or family communication the platform describes. The product is tracked under Education and Research AI because it surfaced in research for The AI Ready School, and the record states plainly that this placement was not independently verified.

For AI scaling, the entry carries no signal. There is no compute footprint, no data center, no power draw, no model, and no hardware. A software layer sold to early childhood programs does not sit on the grid constraint that governs training and inference at scale, and nothing here suggests it does.

What the data does not cover is most of what a reader would want. AI features are unverified, privacy terms are unverified, and pricing is custom by quote, with one user review claiming some states provide it free to providers. The record also notes there are no child accounts, which limits but does not resolve the privacy question for a product used by families and staff. Treat the AI label as a research tag, not a finding.

profile_text.body:
Brightwheel describes itself on its website as an all-in-one childcare management platform covering billing, communication, and attendance, and as the most trusted platform of its kind. The site invites prospective customers to start the school year with one less thing to worry about, and its contact form states that the company may reach people by phone call, SMS, or email, including through automated technology, prerecorded messages, or AI-assisted systems, for marketing and informational purposes.

The site's stated audience is early childhood programs and the families they serve. Brightwheel is tracked as a product in the Education and Research AI category, with a note that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and has not been independently verified, and that its AI features are likewise unverified. Its listed use is child care management and family communication, for early childhood programs, families, and staff, with no child accounts. Pricing is listed as custom by quote, and a user review notes that some states provide it free to providers.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are recorded for the company.
